requirements.title: ASSOCIATE execution evaluates selectors before executing the block
requirements.source: 11.1.3.2 p1 first sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p204.
requirements.definition: Executing an ASSOCIATE construct evaluates every expression within every selector that is a variable designator and evaluates every other selector, followed by execution of the block. This establishes selector values or variable associations before block execution; it does not prescribe expression evaluation order among selectors or authorize side-effect/count oracles.

pending.expression-selector-value-before-block: PENDING positive-control source shape where an expression selector computes a value distinct from later changes to its operands, checked by reading the associate name inside the block.
pending.variable-designator-subexpressions-befor: PENDING positive-control source shape with a variable selector containing a subscript expression whose value selects a nondefault element before block assignment; no function side effects or call counts are used.
pending.block-executes-after-selector-evaluation: PENDING positive-control source shape where the block assigns through an associate name only after selector association is established, with direct final value checks.

requirements.oracle: Use side-effect-free selector expressions and direct values. Do not infer order among multiple selector evaluations or count evaluations.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future ASSOCIATE fixtures must use non-vacuous selectors and sentinels: lower bounds must differ where bounds are asserted, character length must be checked with LEN rather than inferred from padded comparison, outer homonyms must start with values different from any inner assignment, and assignment through an associate name is credited only after the selector is established definable. No plan may count selector evaluations, depend on function side effects, assume a real or complex kind exists, or use compiler agreement as an oracle.

requirements.title: During the ASSOCIATE block each associate name identifies an entity associated with its selector
requirements.source: 11.1.3.2 p1 second sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p204.
requirements.definition: During execution of the ASSOCIATE block, each associate name identifies an entity associated with the corresponding selector. The lifetime/scope of that construct entity and the general association relation are Clause 19 dependencies.

requirements.definition: The associating entity assumes the declared type and type parameters of the selector. If and only if the selector is polymorphic, the associating entity is polymorphic. Dynamic type and additional attributes are owned by 11.1.3.3.

review_rationale: batch111: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...). This batch opens Clause 11, so it establishes the shape later Clause 11 packets follow. The reviewer read all 44 base units of 11.1.1 Blocks, 11.1.2.1 Control flow in blocks, 11.1.2.2 Execution of a block, 11.1.3.1 through 11.1.3.4 the ASSOCIATE construct, and 11.1.4 the BLOCK construct in the original PDF rather than the author summary, verifying the titles from the source and confirming 44 base / 77 fine units, 42 requirements and 119 facets (all pending). The accounting claim was verified independently: the 20 numbered items R1101 in 11.1.1, R1102 through R1106 with C1101 through C1106 in 11.1.3.1, and R1107 through R1110 with C1107 through C1110 in 11.1.4 were already inventoried, so 24 non-numbered units are newly accounted, with no double count and no drop. Five permissions were adjudicated and accepted, including the 11.1.4 p3 explicit processor latitude for specification-expression evaluation order, which carries no plan asserting the processor took a particular order. Critically, the sentences of the form it is permissible to branch to an end statement only from within its construct do two things at once, permitting the inward branch and through the word only prohibiting the outward one, and the reviewer confirmed the packet captures both halves rather than losing a restriction or a permission. The attribution table was audited in full: all 30 negative rows were checked, including the R1109 row whose prohibiting words are a grammar production rather than a shall, the seven C1107 rows drawn from one prohibition list covering COMMON, EQUIVALENCE, INTENT, NAMELIST, OPTIONAL, statement functions and VALUE, the three C1101 rows and the four rows filed under 11.1.3.3 p5 that quote long compound sentences, confirming each negative isolates exactly one clause. The author's decision to treat C1104 as source-classification only was independently examined and accepted, because ordinary pointer assignment is conforming through the variable selector alternative, and 11.1.3.4's zero facets were accepted because its single note base unit and fine unit remain accounted. Decision: source-eligible, no blocking findings. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it approves no oracle.
